user.description: What do you want to add?

menu_options.importa: Import the previous integrations (stove and thermostat)

stufa.title: Pellet stove
stufa.description: Pick the power sensor of the smart plug, the switch that turns the stove on and off, and optionally the plug switch (only its state is shown). Thresholds, timings and notifications are set afterwards in the preferences.

termostato.title: Heating thermostat
termostato.description: Pick the thermostat to control. Optionally add a temperature sensor, the entity telling when nobody is home and the guests entity. Frost protection, limits and announcements are set afterwards in the preferences.

importa.title: Import
importa.description: Found these entries from the previous integrations: {voci}. They are imported with the same settings, schedule and entity names (history included); the old entries are removed. Before continuing remove the two old integrations from HACS (stufa_pellet and termostato_riscaldamento) and restart Home Assistant.

stufa.title: Stove preferences
stufa.description: The same preferences as the cog window on the card.

data.shutdown_needs_switch_off: Detect shutdown only while the stove switch is off
data.grace_seconds: Grace period after the stove switch turns on (s)
data.restore_delay_seconds: Resume after the sensor is back (s)
data.sync_switch_on: Turn the stove switch on when the stove starts by itself
data.sync_switch_off: Turn the stove switch off when the stove is off
data.notify_events: Notify on every start and stop
data.notify_sensor_problem: Notify if the sensor is unavailable
data.show_switch_button: Show the on/off button on the card

termostato.title: Thermostat preferences
termostato.description: The same preferences as the cog window on the card.

data.frost_keep_heat: Outside the program keep the thermostat on at frost protection
data.away_setback: Set back to frost protection when nobody is home
data.away_minutes: Minutes of empty house before setting back
